errors.description: The final characterization as a unique maximal exponential divisor is false as stated: for a prime absent from every initial number, any positive exponent divides all zero valuations, so arbitrarily many such primes may be adjoined. This remark can simply be deleted.
errors.quote: the unique maximal $d$ with $v_p(d) \mid v_p(a_i)$ for all $p$ and all $i$.

parsed.notes: Both requested parts are proved correctly. The termination potential and prime-wise valuation invariant are valid; the omitted divisibility detail in Step 3 is routine. Only the extraneous final remark is erroneous.
